description: This file defines the ConfigurationProvider class for AWS STS regional endpoints, providing methods to obtain configuration settings from environment variables, ini files, or fallback defaults, and includes logic for caching and composition of providers.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: A configuration provider for AWS STS regional endpoints, capable of sourcing configuration from environment variables, ini files, or defaults, with support for chaining and caching.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider chain that checks environment variables, ini files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a provider that sources configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback configuration options when other sources are unavailable.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider based on a profile in an ini configuration file.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Converts a configuration source (callable, promise, array, string) into a ConfigurationInterface object.
